source: The numbers the paper reports for Apsis on the benchmark suite: Table 4 (per framework), the Apsis rows of Table 5 (per category) and Fig. 8 (structural-only versus full catalog). `scripts/evaluate.py --check` compares a run with them.
metric: tp = buggy artifacts with at least one finding; fn = buggy artifacts with none; fp = fixed twins with at least one finding. structural_only_tp = buggy artifacts still flagged when the behavioral detectors are switched off: readiness-liveness, channel-write-merge and read-after-write, which read the mandatory/default input flags and the semantics of shared state (a channel's reducer, who reads and writes a key).

analysis_time.note: Time per artifact, front-end plus analysis, of a sequential run (scripts/evaluate.py --jobs 1) on a 4-core Arm Neoverse-N1 machine; three runs over the 270 artifacts gave medians of 0.65, 0.63 and 0.66 s and means of 0.85, 0.82 and 0.83 s. Depends on the machine, so --check does not compare it.
